sloka: तस्य व्यायच्छमानस्य रामस्य अर्थे अथ रावणः ।पक्षौ पादौ च पार्श्वौ च खड्गम् उद्धृत्य सो अच्छिनत् ॥३-५१-४२॥
transliteration: tasya vyāyacchamānasya rāmasya arthe atha rāvaṇaḥ ।pakṣau pādau ca pārśvau ca khaḍgam uddhṛtya so acchinat ॥3-51-42॥

translations.english: Ravana lifted his sword and cut off both the wings and feet of Jatayu who was fighting relentlessly (for Rama's sake).
